description.p: MarkDownGonzo is a local-first, WYSIWYG Markdown editor that writes clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown. You work in a polished document; the file on disk stays an ordinary .md.

ul.li: Visual and raw editing modes, one keystroke apart
Clean GFM output with byte-for-byte YAML frontmatter preservation
Tables, task lists, blockquotes, syntax-highlighted code, and images
Paste, drag-and-drop, or pick images; assets copied next to the document
Autosave, external-change detection, session restore, recent-notes sidebar
Find and replace, printing, and export to ODT (and PDF via LibreOffice)
No accounts, no sync, no database, no telemetry

description.p: First public build: visual/raw editing, GFM round-tripping, images, find and replace, printing, and ODT/PDF export.
